health.title: Account health
health.subtitle: Diagnose mailbox problems and see fix hints across the organisation.
health.hint_app_password_required_detail: Gmail, iCloud and Yahoo often block normal passwords for IMAP. Create an app-specific password and use that instead.
health.hint_imap_disabled_detail: Enable IMAP in the provider account settings, then reconnect.
health.hint_wrong_host_port_tls_title: Wrong host, port or TLS mode
health.hint_wrong_host_port_tls_detail: Check IMAP host, port and TLS (implicit on 993, STARTTLS on 143).
health.hint_certificate_problem_detail: Fix the server certificate, or only as a last resort enable ignore-certificate-errors.
health.hint_oauth_consent_revoked_detail: Reconnect the account and grant consent again.
health.hint_rate_limited_detail: Wait a few minutes, reduce concurrent sessions, then retry.
health.hint_mailbox_full_detail: Free space at the provider so sync can continue.
health.hint_auth_failed_detail: Update credentials or reconnect with OAuth.
health.hint_connect_failed_detail: Check network, firewall and that the host is reachable.
health.hint_capacity_detail: No sync node has room right now; the account will be placed when capacity frees up.
health.hint_ignore_cert_errors_detail: This account accepts invalid TLS certificates. Turn off ignore-certificate-errors after fixing the server certificate.
